parsed_json.up: Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter to target chembl_id CHEMBL4247, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, target_dictionary tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate. Order by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value.
